judged_text: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts setting values verbatim (e.g. 'http://eviltrout.com', 'https://example.com/1234' — forms the old setting and its specs accepted) while the runtime lookup EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares lower(host) = uri.host, i.e. bare lowercase hostname. After upgrade, every migrated host row that carries a scheme or path never matches the lookup, so EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? returns false for previously-working referers and ensure_embeddable raises Discourse::InvalidAccess — embedded comments break site-wide for those hosts with no error surfaced to the admin, because the model's before_validation normalization is bypassed by the raw SQL insert.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the legacy SiteSetting 'embeddable_hosts' values are inserted via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running the EmbeddableHost model's `before_validation` normalization that strips scheme/path. Runtime checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which parses the incoming URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, i.e. bare hostname. Therefore migrated rows containing values like `http://...` or `.../path` will not match `uri.host`, causing `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` to return false and `ensure_embeddable` to reject previously allowed referers.
